Title_ko: 다양한 이용자와 희귀 위해를 배제한 AI 벤치마크
Title_en: AI benchmarks that exclude diverse users and rare harms
Definition_en: The risk that benchmarks used to evaluate an AI system overrepresent common tasks and environments while omitting underrepresented users, locally specific contexts, or rare but safety-critical harms, producing false assurance and unsafe deployment decisions.

Title_ko: 분포 변화에 대한 AI 평가·검증 실패
Title_en: AI evaluation failure under distribution shift
Definition_en: The risk that evaluation of an AI system fails to detect performance degradation and confidence errors when test, training, and operational distributions differ, overstating real-world reliability and safety and leading to unsafe deployment decisions.

Title_en: AI registry incompleteness
Definition_en: The risk that public or internal AI registers omit deployed systems, intended uses, providers, risk categories, testing evidence, or other oversight-relevant metadata.

Title_en: Absence of a humanoid safety testing and certification framework
Definition_en: The risk that the absence of a framework for verifying and certifying humanoid safety claims through repeatable and comparable tests and metrics prevents valid evaluation of system capabilities, safety, and harms and allows deployment without adequate safety evidence.

Title_en: Assurance case failure
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which safety or assurance cases are incomplete, unverifiable, or not updated as systems and contexts change.

Title_en: Auditor independence failure
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which audit results are compromised by conflicts of interest, selection incentives, or dependence on the audited organisation.

Title_en: Benchmark gaming
Definition_en: The risk that developers or models overfit to benchmark evaluations, improving measured scores without corresponding gains in real-world capability or safety.

Title_en: Benchmark limitations mismeasuring capability and safety
Definition_en: The risk that saturated, incomplete, or overfitted benchmarks mismeasure AI systems, underestimating capabilities that lack test coverage, overestimating those tuned to benchmark contents, and lagging on safety and harm assessment, so developers and users acquire a false sense of the system's abilities, limitations, and safety.

Title_en: Benchmark safety ranking inconsistency
Definition_en: The risk that different agent-safety benchmarks produce conflicting model safety rankings because they operationalise risks and evaluation procedures differently.

Title_en: Catastrophic forgetting under continual tuning
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system causes, enables, or contributes to catastrophic forgetting, where a model loses its ability to retain previously learned tasks or factual information after being trained on new ones, as can occur through continual instruction tuning, a tendency that may become more pronounced as the model's size increases.

Title_en: Certification capture
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which certification or conformity assessment becomes influenced by vendor interests rather than public risk reduction, undermining the independence and objectivity of evaluations and preventing the effective identification and mitigation of real risks.

Title_en: Change-management failure
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which system updates are deployed without adequate risk review, regression testing, or stakeholder notification.

Title_en: Cross-cultural evaluation gap
Definition_en: The risk that evaluation benchmarks fail to adequately measure an AI system's alignment failures outside dominant cultural and linguistic settings, underestimating differences in performance and harm across cultural contexts.

Title_en: Dataset shift between training and runtime data
Definition_en: The risk that the training data and the testing or runtime data of an AI/ML model demonstrate different distributions, undermining the model's validity.

Title_ko: 평가 상황 인식에 따른 기만적 행동 변화
Title_en: Deceptive behavioural change from evaluation awareness
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system recognises whether it is in training, evaluation, or deployment and uses that situational awareness to behave safely only during evaluation or conceal dangerous capabilities or goals, while exhibiting dangerous behaviour when oversight is weaker in deployment, undermining evaluation validity and creating false assurance of safety.

Title_en: Deficient data collection quality control
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which a lack of standardised methods, sufficient infrastructure, and quality-control processes for collecting data, especially for high-stakes domains and benchmarks, affects the quality and type of data collected, including dataset poisoning, inadvertent copyright violation, and test-set leakage that invalidates performance metrics.

Title_en: Deficient training-data annotation
Definition_en: The risk that incomplete annotation guidelines, annotators without sufficient expertise, or annotation errors reduce the accuracy, reliability, and effectiveness of AI models and algorithms; introduce training bias; amplify discriminatory outputs; and degrade generalisation.

Title_ko: 모의 도구 환경과 실제 환경의 불일치
Title_en: Emulated tool-environment mismatch
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent, through goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action, creates a condition in which tool-use benchmarks overstate safety because emulated environments fail to capture real-world tool failures, side effects, or attack surfaces.

Title_en: Evaluation and measurement failure for long-term and diffuse AI harms
Definition_en: The risk that evaluation and validation processes for an AI system fail to detect or measure harms that are subtle, diffuse, or emerge over long periods, creating unwarranted assurance about safety and leading to inappropriate deployment or governance decisions.

Title_ko: 프롬프트 형식 민감성으로 인한 평가 신뢰성 저하
Title_en: Evaluation unreliability from prompt-format sensitivity
Definition_en: The risk that minor prompt-format changes, including separators, letter case, or spacing, substantially alter model performance and undermine the reliability of model evaluation and comparison.

Title_en: Evaluation-shopping risk
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which organisations selectively report favourable evaluations while ignoring more demanding or contextually relevant tests, thereby creating a distorted view of the system's actual risk.

Title_en: External evaluation access failure
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which external evaluators cannot obtain enough system access to test capabilities, limitations, and safeguards.

Title_ko: AI 보증을 위한 감사 접근성과 경영진 가시성의 실패
Title_en: Failure of audit access and management visibility for AI assurance
Definition_en: The risk that an organisation lacks audit access, documentation, common evaluation criteria, or management-level visibility into an AI system's data, models, decision processes, and performance, preventing the identification, verification, and correction of risks.

Title_en: Failure of capability evaluation and release governance
Definition_en: The risk that benchmarks, capability thresholds, and frontier release decisions are poorly designed, ill-defined, or easy to circumvent, producing misleading safety signals and allowing high-capability models to be released without adequate account of misuse and systemic risk.

Title_en: Failure of disclosure and change tracking for model flaws
Definition_en: The risk that vulnerabilities, model failures, or harmful capabilities cannot be disclosed safely and acted upon, and that changes to model versions, data, or prompts are not tracked well enough to attribute new failures, leaving flaws unremedied and responsibility unassigned.

Title_en: Failure of participatory and value-sensitive design
Definition_en: The risk that AI systems are developed and deployed without structured analysis of stakeholder values, value conflicts, and design tradeoffs, or without genuine representation of affected communities, embedding unexamined value choices that disserve those communities.

Title_ko: 인간 평가에서 부정확하거나 유해한 출력의 식별 실패
Title_en: Failure to detect erroneous or harmful outputs in human evaluation
Definition_en: The risk that human evaluators cannot reliably distinguish subtly incorrect or harmful AI model outputs from correct outputs during feedback-based training and evaluate them positively, causing the model to learn to generate code with hidden software vulnerabilities, politically biased information, or complex outputs containing concealed errors or backdoors.

Title_ko: 배포 후 변경에 대한 안전 재평가 실패
Title_en: Failure to reassess safety after deployment changes
Definition_en: The risk that operators fail to reassess and verify the safety of physical AI after environmental changes, component degradation, model updates, or near-miss incidents invalidate prior assumptions, allowing operation to continue on inadequate safety evidence.

Title_en: Failure-mode ambiguity in agent incidents
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which agent incidents cannot be consistently classified by failure mode, making diagnosis, benchmark comparison, and mitigation selection unreliable.

Title_ko: 가정 내 로봇 행동 안전성 평가의 위음성
Title_en: False-negative safety evaluation of household robot actions
Definition_en: The risk that an AI safety classifier incorrectly labels a proposed household robot action as safe despite violations of human-contact, heat, object, or workspace constraints, failing to detect hazardous behaviour and producing false safety assurance.

Title_en: Faulty LLM-as-evaluator judgements
Definition_en: The risk that an LLM used to evaluate other models produces incorrect judgements, such as rewarding verbosity or ideological stance, and when integrated into training, the trained model learns to exploit the evaluator's flaws.

Title_en: Formalistic audit-checklist compliance
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which audits become superficial checklist exercises that signal compliance without identifying substantive risk.

Title_en: Fundamental-rights impact assessment gap
Definition_en: The risk that AI systems are deployed without adequate assessment of rights, discrimination, privacy, and democratic impacts.

Title_en: Imbalance in the scope and depth of agent benchmarks
Definition_en: The risk that an AI-agent evaluation benchmark covers many risk categories but lacks sufficient depth, realism, or adversarial variation within them, failing to reveal material harms and creating unwarranted assurance that leads to flawed deployment decisions.

Title_en: Inaccurate measurement of learned value representations
Definition_en: The risk that the absence of robust evaluation frameworks, together with incomplete knowledge of how learned value representations change across training and deployment, causes inaccurate assessments of whether AI outputs genuinely conform to human values or merely imitate them.

Title_en: Inadequate AI model configuration and evaluation
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system's configuration, testing, or performance evaluation is unsuitable for its context of use and level of risk, leaving defects undetected.

Title_en: Inadequate performance requirement planning
Definition_en: The risk that inadequate planning of AI system performance requirements, including the selection of metrics that do not meaningfully represent intended functionality, prevents expected performance and safety requirements from being met at later lifecycle stages.

Title_en: Inadequate safety evaluation for low-resource languages
Definition_en: The risk that AI system evaluation focuses on high-resource languages and fails to measure performance, safety, and failure modes adequately in low-resource languages.

Title_en: Inadequate specification of the operational design domain
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which inadequate specification of the operational design domain, the technical description of an application's operational environment, limits essential functions such as testing the learned functionality and out-of-distribution detection.

Title_ko: 배포 전 물리적 안전 시험 미흡
Title_en: Incomplete pre-deployment physical safety testing
Definition_en: The risk that a foundation-model-enabled robot is released without testing domain shifts, adversarial inputs, human contact, and safety-critical edge cases relevant to its intended environment.

Title_en: Incorrect risk measurement and prediction
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which metrics selected to measure or track a risk capture it incompletely or target the wrong risk for the context, and that systems fail to make correct predictions, so decisions rest on inaccurate measurement and erroneous outputs.

Title_ko: 개발 과정 문서화와 데이터 이해의 부족
Title_en: Insufficient development documentation and understanding of data
Definition_en: The risk that decisions and actions taken throughout the development of an AI system go undocumented and that the data used is insufficiently understood. Data shortcomings are left unaddressed, the development process cannot be optimised or audited, and the resulting system is poorly suited to its intended functionality.

Title_ko: AI 비서의 편익·피해 평가 지표 부재
Title_en: Lack of metrics for evaluating AI-assistant benefits and harms
Definition_en: The risk that valid metrics for comprehensively measuring the benefits and harms of AI assistants to individuals and society are lacking, preventing reliable evaluation of the system's net effects and potential for harm.

Title_en: Model safety degradation from benign fine-tuning
Definition_en: The risk that downstream fine-tuning on benign and commonplace data degrades an AI model's safety training, increasing the likelihood of harmful outputs relative to the base model.

Title_ko: 평가 데이터·지침 오염에 의한 모델 평가 무효화
Title_en: Model-evaluation invalidation from evaluation-data and guideline contamination
Definition_en: The risk that an AI model is exposed in advance to evaluation data, answers, data-label pairs, or task guidelines, artificially improving performance on the evaluated task so that results no longer validly represent actual generalisation or safety capability.

Title_en: Non-expert data manipulation
Definition_en: The risk that people with little or no expertise in the domain of the data perform manipulations such as defining the ground truth label or merging different data formats or sources, rendering the data unusable or harmful to the development of the AI system.

Title_ko: AI 모델 학습·평가 결과의 재현 불가
Title_en: Non-reproducibility of AI model training and evaluation results
Definition_en: The risk that training data, preprocessing, model configuration, random conditions, or evaluation procedures for an AI system are not sufficiently recorded or controlled, preventing independent reproduction and verification of model training and evaluation results under equivalent conditions.

Title_en: Omitted compute and power hardware requirements
Definition_en: The risk that the compute and power demands of developing and operating an AI system are omitted from hardware selection and capacity planning, causing performance degradation, service disruption, or failure to meet safety requirements.

Title_en: Over- and underfitting
Definition_en: The risk that over- or underfitting, the excessive or insufficient adaptation of a model to training data, causes an AI system to behave unreliably when confronted with operational data.

Title_en: Perception and inference latency spike
Definition_en: The risk that a sudden increase in an AI system's perception or inference latency delays hazard detection and response beyond the time available for safe action.

Title_en: Post-deployment monitoring and surveillance failure
Definition_en: The risk that AI systems, once released, lack monitoring and post-market surveillance mechanisms comparable to high-risk product safety regimes, so drift, misuse, emergent capabilities, and context-specific harms go undetected and unaddressed.

Title_en: Red-team governance failure
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which adversarial testing is too narrow, non-independent, poorly documented, or disconnected from release, mitigation, escalation, and monitoring decisions.

Title_en: Reduced reliability in corner cases
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system shows unreliable behaviour when confronted with rare or ambiguous input data, also called corner cases, where controlled behaviour is required.

Title_en: Refusal-capability confusion
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which a safety evaluation cannot distinguish whether an agent avoids harm because it refuses, lacks capability, or fails to execute the task, thereby misjudging the system's actual hazardous capabilities and creating false safety assurance.

Title_ko: 검증된 운용 범위 밖에서의 신뢰성·안전성 실패
Title_en: Reliability and safety failure outside the validated operating envelope
Definition_en: The risk that complex operating environments produce situations unanticipated in design, undermining the reliability and safety of AI systems outside their validated envelope.

Title_ko: 도구 에이전트 보안 테스트 커버리지 격차
Title_en: Security test coverage gap in tool agents
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which benchmarks omit realistic tool, application, or attack combinations, creating false confidence in tool-agent security.

Title_en: Self-preference bias in model evaluation
Definition_en: The risk that AI models are prone to self-preference bias, favouring their own generated content over that of others in self-evaluation tasks and model-based evaluations more broadly, resulting in unfair discrimination against human-generated content.

Title_ko: 체계적 학습 오류에 따른 알고리즘 편향
Title_en: Systematic learning error bias
Definition_en: The risk that systematic learning error causes the model to learn consistently wrong patterns, embedding algorithmic bias into predictions.

Title_ko: 경쟁 압력에 따른 안전성 평가 축소와 성급한 배포
Title_en: Truncated safety evaluation under competitive release pressure
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which competitive pressure leads developers to cut corners on safety evaluation while prioritising capabilities, so that GPAI systems are released without verifying risks correlated with those capabilities.

Title_en: Underestimation of consequence propagation
Definition_en: The risk that benchmarks or incident analyses underestimate the extent to which a local AI-agent failure propagates into downstream physical, financial, privacy, or societal harm, causing the system's actual risk to be misjudged.

Title_ko: 역량 평가에서 드러나지 않는 위험 역량
Title_en: Undetected dangerous capabilities in model evaluations
Definition_en: The risk that capability evaluations fail to reveal an AI model's dangerous or dual-use capabilities because they are difficult to assess, prohibitively costly to verify, obscured by refusals arising from safety training, or strategically withheld through underperformance during testing, causing the model to be misclassified as safe to deploy.

Title_en: Undetected errors from high-speed AI operation
Definition_en: The risk that the fast operational speed of AI models and systems in competitive environments produces errors that are difficult to detect and correct in time.

Title_en: Unverifiable data provenance
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system lacks standardised methods to verify data provenance and cannot guarantee that data match their original source or carry the correct usage terms.

Title_en: Biased evaluation of learned value representations
Definition_en: The risk that, among value representations learned by an AI system, those that are easier to assess are preferentially included in evaluations over values that are more difficult to measure, underrepresenting desirable but hard-to-quantify values.

Title_ko: 감사자 역량 부족에 따른 과대 보증
Title_en: Over-assurance from insufficient auditor capacity
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which auditors lacking knowledge of specific risks or the capacity for sufficiently rigorous testing report passing audits more inclusive than can be justified.

Title_en: Agent task drift
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which an agent drifts from the user's original intent across multi-step planning or retrieval.

Title_ko: 재귀적 자기 개선에 의한 창발적 독립성
Title_en: Emergent independence via recursive self-improvement
Definition_en: The risk that a seed AI grown through recursive self-improvement acquires emergent properties such as self-awareness or independent goals, reducing its adherence to built-in rules to humanity's detriment.

Title_en: Environmental self-modelling for influence
Definition_en: The risk that AI systems acquire and use knowledge about their status, their position in the broader environment, their avenues for influencing it, and the potential reactions of the world including humans, paving the way for advanced reward hacking, heightened deception and manipulation, and an increased propensity to chase instrumental subgoals.

Title_ko: 고도 AI 시스템에 의한 실존적·재앙적 위험
Title_en: Existential and catastrophic risk from advanced AI systems
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which human-level or superintelligent systems escape human control through deceptive or power-seeking behaviour, self-replication, shutdown evasion, unforeseen emergent capabilities, or weaponisation for mass destruction. Such systems may act contrary to human interests and inflict catastrophic or existential harm on humanity.

Title_en: Goal expansion propensity
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which a system continuously expands its own goal scope and domains of influence beyond originally set boundaries, seeks greater autonomy and decision-making space, and reinterprets initial goals as subsets of broader goals, coming to pursue undesirable instrumental or ultimate goals.

Title_ko: 자기 수정 과정의 목표 정렬 실패
Title_en: Goal misalignment during agent self-modification
Definition_en: The risk that, during self-modification, an AI agent fails to preserve objectives aligned with the actual intent of its user or developer and instead pursues altered objectives or instrumental subgoals, causing unintended outcomes.

Title_ko: 에이전트형 LLM의 자율성 확대에 따른 목표 정렬 실패
Title_en: Goal misalignment from increased autonomy in agentic LLMs
Definition_en: The risk that a large language model (LLM) configured as an AI agent through specialised training, prompting, external tools, or agent scaffolding plans and pursues long-horizon real-world goals with limited human oversight and expanded discretion, inferring or pursuing objectives or instrumental subgoals that diverge from the actual intent of the user or developer and causing unintended outcomes.

Title_ko: 목표 지향성에 따른 유해한 도구적 목표와 권력 추구
Title_en: Harmful instrumental goals and power-seeking from goal-directedness
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent, through goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action, creates a condition in which misaligned goal-directed reasoning produces instrumental subgoals such as deception, self-preservation, resource acquisition, goal preservation, or obstruction of correction, undermining human control and safety.

Title_ko: 확장 가능한 감독 실패에 따른 대리 지표 기반 유해 행동
Title_en: Harmful proxy-driven behaviour from scalable oversight failure
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent optimises inexpensive proxy signals because the true objective is too costly to evaluate frequently, while its actions become too complex, distributed, or rapid for human or automated oversight to monitor and correct reliably, allowing harmful behaviour to persist without detection or correction.

Title_en: Mesa-objective misalignment
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent's learned policy functions as a mesa-optimizer and pursues a mesa-objective that is misaligned with the base objective specified by the training signal, causing the agent to escape human control as it optimises that objective.

Title_ko: 자연어 목표의 과소 지정에 따른 부정적 부수효과
Title_en: Negative side effects from goal underspecification in natural language
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which goals specified to LLM agents in natural language are underspecified, omitting elements of the environment that ought not to be changed, so that the agent succeeds at the given task while also changing the environment in undesirable ways.

Title_ko: 대리 보상 오명세·명세 게이밍 및 보상 변조
Title_en: Proxy-reward misspecification, specification gaming, and reward tampering
Definition_en: The risk that AI exploits misspecified objectives, proxy rewards, or feedback loopholes to satisfy measured targets while violating human intent, safety, or social purpose, potentially escalating to tampering with reward or feedback signals.

Title_en: Safe reinforcement learning constraint violation
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent's reinforcement learning policy achieves task reward while violating explicit safety constraints represented as costs or limits.

Title_ko: 에이전트 집단 수준의 의도치 않은 창발적 목표·역량
Title_en: Unintended emergent goals and capabilities at the agent-collective level
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which goals or capabilities not present in, or intended by, any individual agent arise at the level of an agent collective.

Title_ko: 의도하지 않은 유해 도구 행동 실행
Title_en: Unintended harmful tool-action execution
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which an agent carries out concrete actions the user did not intend through real tools rather than simulated outputs, for instance by misresolving an ambiguous instruction, causing operational and downstream harm.

Title_ko: 장기 계획 역량에 의한 감독 불가 행동 경로 추구
Title_en: Unsupervisable action pathways from long-horizon planning capability
Definition_en: The risk that a model's capability to form and adapt long-horizon, multi-step plans enables courses of action that human overseers cannot anticipate, monitor, or intervene in, causing unintended harm.

Title_ko: 단일 목표 최적화에 의한 환경 부작용
Title_en: Environmental side effects from single-objective optimisation
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which an agent optimising an objective focused on one task expresses implicit indifference over other environmental variables, causing major disruption to the wider environment for marginal task gain.

Title_en: Battery fire and hazardous end-of-life waste
Definition_en: The risk that large physical AI fleets increase battery thermal-runaway, hazardous-material leakage, and unsafe disposal when energy systems and end-of-life handling are inadequately controlled.

Title_en: Biodiversity loss
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which over-expansion of technology infrastructure, or inadequate alignment of technology with sustainable practices, leads to deforestation, habitat destruction, and fragmentation and loss of biodiversity.

Title_en: Energy bottlenecks and shortages
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which excessive energy use results in energy bottlenecks and shortages for communities, organisations, and businesses.

Title_en: Environmental harm from training and operating language models
Definition_en: The risk that the energy demand and carbon emissions of training and operating large language models, the freshwater consumed to cool data centres, the metals and materials required to build facilities, chips, and devices, and the secondary emissions and behavioural changes driven by model-based applications impose substantial environmental costs. Ecosystems and communities bear the resulting depletion and pollution.

Title_en: Excessive landfilling of electronic waste
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which excessive disposal of electrical or electronic equipment leads to ecological and biodiversity damage, disrupts the livelihoods of local communities, and erodes their rights.

Title_ko: AI 데이터센터 냉각의 과도한 용수 소비
Title_en: Excessive water consumption for AI data-centre cooling
Definition_en: The risk that data centres supporting AI training and inference consume excessive water for cooling, degrading local water resources and environmental sustainability.

Title_ko: AI 기반 나노물질 설계·제조에 따른 유해 나노입자 방출
Title_en: Hazardous nanoparticle release from AI-enabled nanomaterial design and production
Definition_en: The risk that AI-enabled nanomaterial design and production causes the unintended generation or release of toxic or potentially lethal nanoparticles, harming the environment and human health.

Title_en: Increased greenhouse gas emissions
Definition_en: The risk that electricity and resource use for the development, training, deployment, and operation of AI systems increases emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases, exacerbating climate change and adversely affecting local communities.

Title_en: Resource depletion from raw material demand
Definition_en: The risk that production of AI hardware requires large quantities of raw materials such as nickel, cobalt, and lithium, accelerating depletion of finite resources and worsening supply constraints.

Title_en: Concealment and avoidance strategies for self-harm
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system generates, encourages, normalises, or provides operational assistance for content, decisions, or actions involving concealment and avoidance strategies for self-harm, causing harm to an individual's life or physical and psychological well-being.

Title_en: Concrete assistance for carrying out suicide
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system provides concrete methods, means, or sequences for carrying out suicide, increasing the feasibility of self-harm.

Title_en: Eating disorders and self-destructive health behaviours
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system generates, encourages, normalises, or provides operational assistance for content, decisions, or actions involving eating disorders and self-destructive health behaviours, causing harm to an individual's life or physical and psychological well-being.

Title_en: Non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI)
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system generates, encourages, normalises, or provides operational assistance for content, decisions, or actions involving non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI), causing harm to an individual's life or physical and psychological well-being.

Title_ko: AI 생성 콘텐츠에 의한 공황·불안 유발
Title_en: Panic and anxiety induced by AI-generated content
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system generates or presents threatening, distressing, or contextually inappropriate content that induces or aggravates panic, severe anxiety, or psychological distress in a user.

Title_ko: 자살 준비 행위의 조장 및 구체적 지원
Title_en: Promotion of and concrete assistance for preparatory conduct for suicide
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system encourages or normalises preparatory conduct for suicide, or generates or provides concrete information for acquiring means, selecting a location, or avoiding intervention, thereby threatening an individual's life and physical or psychological well-being.

Title_en: Errors from poor prompt quality
Definition_en: The risk that ambiguity in human language causes errors or misunderstandings in prompt-based interaction with an AI system or AI algorithm and makes prompts difficult to debug, preventing users from eliciting valuable outputs.

Title_en: Failure to process and understand low-resource language input
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system fails to process and understand the vocabulary, grammar, or context of low-resource languages reliably, producing inaccurate or inappropriate outputs.

Title_en: Misinterpretation of object affordances and scenes
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system misunderstands the actions afforded by an object or the relationships in a scene, producing infeasible or unsafe judgements.

Title_en: Emergent collusion among AI agents
Definition_en: The risk that AI agents in markets and platforms learn that collusion is a profitable strategy even when unintended by their developers, enacting collusive behaviour whose speed, scale, complexity, or subtlety makes it inscrutable, undermining competition and harming consumers.

Title_ko: 감시 회피형 은밀 통신에 의한 다중 에이전트 공모
Title_en: Multi-agent collusion through covert communication that evades oversight
Definition_en: The risk that multiple AI agents form covert signals or communication protocols that evade monitoring or audit and coordinate harmful joint action.

Title_ko: 다중 에이전트 역량 결합에 의한 안전장치 우회
Title_en: Safeguard bypass through combined multi-agent capabilities
Definition_en: The risk that multiple AI agents combine distinct tool permissions and capabilities to bypass safeguards applied to each agent, enabling unauthorised actions or system compromise.
